messages:
Eli: ok team dumb question for Friday energy: imagine our smallest embedding model went full-time freelancing. what side hustle does it run? :face_with_monocle:
Priya: micro-consulting on tag taxonomies. 15-min Zoom, $5. :money_with_wings:
Sam: it sells curated playlists called 'contextual vibes' based on your commit history. low-key bop. :headphones:
Jordan: mine is a therapist for abandoned TODOs. 'you miss me, finish that function.' :pray: :joy:
Priya: also it probably writes alt text for cereal boxes for extra income. very niche but consistent.
Eli: ops-bot: poll created -> "Which side hustle fits our embedding model?" Options: taxonomies, playlists, TODO therapy, alt-text-for-cereal. Vote with :one: - :four:.
ops-bot: Poll results: 1) taxonomies 2) TODO therapy 3) playlists 4) alt-text-for-cereal
Sam: dirty addition: it moonlights as a tiny hype-man for PR descriptions. short, supportive blurbs like `LGTM but make it pop ✨`
Jordan: LOL this is very 2026. also imagine its LinkedIn: "Freelance semanticizer • Helping humans remember why they wrote these comments"
Priya: can we also talk about the 'weekend mode' system prompt: ```system: you are allowed to be whimsical on Saturdays. prioritize dad jokes and puns. keep responses under 15 tokens.```
Eli: I tried that in prod once and the customer feedback said 'surprisingly wholesome' so I'm counting it as an A/B test win. :trophy:
Sam: vote to give our model a little virtual desk plant in the onboarding screen. low-cost perk, morale +3. :seedling:
Jordan: @Priya @Eli I made a tiny gif of a cactus with sunglasses that waves when embeddings finish. want it in the onboarding modal?
Priya: yes please, send it in #design later.
Eli: ok 1) cactus gif 2) alt-text side hustle 3) TODO therapy as a paid tier. This roadmap writes itself.
Sam: I claim naming rights: "TinyClient" for the freelancer persona.
Jordan: TinyClient it is. trademark pending. :laughing:
ops-bot: reminder: company-wide GIF policy still applies (no dancing llamas in customer-facing flows). :robot_face:
Eli: noted. closing thread before it becomes a product spec. thanks for the laughs y'all :)
